=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Kiran: "A little gift, before you even have to pry: Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 5 others out."
Kiran: "I did see Jory out on the Market on the first night. I did see Isolde out on the Market last night."  [case board: #50, #51, #52]
Isolde: "It pains me to say this aloud, truly, yet I fear Kiran. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #53, #54]
Kiran: "If we're comparing notes, friends, Lian looks shaky to me. My count of folk abroad that night doesn't square with what we've been told."  [case board: #55]
Lian: "Isolde belongs at the top of our list. My reading, taken with the other reports, leaves them among the likeliest."  [case board: #56]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Seer."
Greta: "The night before you arrived, I looked at Odette and Jory: one of them reads as the demon."
Greta: "On the first night, I looked at Odette and Isolde: one of them reads as the demon."
Greta: "Last night, I looked at Isolde and Lian: neither is the demon."  [case board: #57, #58, #59, #60]
